title: SaaS landing page
description: A product launch page for a runbook automation tool with a glowing hero, an in browser app mockup, features, stats, testimonials and an FAQ.

title: Analytics dashboard
description: A revenue dashboard with a sidebar that collapses into a drawer, KPI sparklines, an inline SVG chart and a real data table.

title: Blog article
description: A long form magazine article with serif typography, a sticky table of contents, a data figure, a callout and related stories.

title: Pricing page
description: Three plans with a monthly and yearly switch built from radio inputs, a feature comparison table and billing questions.

title: Ecommerce product page
description: A product detail page with a scroll snap gallery, color picker cards, quantity stepper, specs, rating breakdown and reviews.

title: Designer portfolio
description: A personal portfolio with illustrated case study covers, an experience timeline, a testimonial and a contact form.

title: Sign in and sign up
description: Sign in and create account screens in one tabbed card that switches without JavaScript, next to a forced dark brand panel.
